target_definition.construction: 100 * dilapidated census houses / total census houses, from D2 (HLPCA) 'Total Number of Dilapidated' on the Rural/Urban == 'Total' row
target_definition.units: percent of census houses in the district
target_definition.scope: district-level prevalence of dilapidated census houses; NOT a measure of individual homelessness

preprocessing: SimpleImputer(strategy='median') then StandardScaler, fitted with the model
